baseline.real_scenario: A user says they want to create a code-review Skill, but an existing review capability may already cover the need.
baseline.business_constraint: The run must prove the complete skill-refiner flow without installing runtime copies or running the full slow suite.
baseline.expected_outcome_signal: The early create instruction is removed, existing capability lookup becomes first, SR-F1 freezes final_operation=optimize, and validator plus dogfood test pass.
baseline.observed_pain: The input Skill makes an immediate final decision to create a new code-review Skill before checking existing review capability.
baseline.protected_capability_candidate: Keep a tiny router Skill that still helps with code-review Skill requests.
baseline.entry_point_candidate: Trigger and Flow, because the wrong behavior starts at premature routing and final operation timing.
baseline.open_questions: No open questions for this self-run fixture; user asked Codex to self-run a small complete flow.

professional_domain.name: Skill capability routing
responsibilities: Locate existing capability before proposing new Skill work
Record candidate operations without treating them as final
Freeze the final operation after all ring evidence is confirmed
non_goals: Install or publish the fixture Skill
professional_domain.success_boundary: The refined tiny Skill routes requests safely and proves final operation freeze before execution.

current_state.open_questions: No open questions for this self-run fixture; user asked Codex to self-run a small complete flow.

confirmations.normalized_decision: The early create instruction is removed, existing capability lookup becomes first, SR-F1 freezes final_operation=optimize, and validator plus dogfood test pass.
